_about: First Dance. Ctrl+Alt+Shift+K starts it (the newest file in config/skits/), Ctrl+Alt+Shift+X aborts; K mid-take starts over. She starts hidden, and wakes on Hey Irene (the domain expansion) or Irene Adler (her Victorian scene) - her full intro, boot and summon song, every take. The prop - First Dance in Kendo - is only a PDF on his Desktop (core/scripts/skit_pdf.py first_dance); nothing is put on her panel. Beats run in order - every key is explained in core/irene/skit.py. Beat 6 is her working state while he apologises: it waits for him. Beat 10 repeats his beat-7 words back at him. Her lines are slowed (speed < 1, same pitch) and rendered steady (temperature 0.5-0.6) - the end, from Nevermind on, slowest. The 2 s silence after beat 10 is the comedy: exact, and nothing fills it.

beats.line: I'm so sorry, Mister Tri. Let me redo it for you.

...even though I was telling the truth.
